# The Ghosts We Carry

> The Ghosts We Carry: From Combat to the Disconnected Generation is a memoir by Steve Bogucki, an Iraq War combat veteran. It is about combat, connection, and what it means to finally stay: survivor's guilt, a lifelong "Pattern of Surrender" (the urge to walk away), the isolation of a generation more connected than ever and more alone, and the love that finally said "don't quit on me." The book is a preliminary final draft (last updated February 3, 2026) and is free to read.

## About the book

- Title: The Ghosts We Carry
- Subtitle: From Combat to the Disconnected Generation
- Author: Steve Bogucki
- Genre: Memoir
- Status: Preliminary final draft, last updated February 3, 2026
- Structure: Prologue, Parts I-XVI, and an Author's Note
- Access: Free to read online or as a PDF; no sign-up required
- Themes: Iraq War combat, survivor's guilt, isolation and loneliness among millennial men, veteran mental health, recovery, and love

## About the author

Steve Bogucki is a combat veteran: OIF I with 2nd Brigade, 3rd Infantry Division during the 2003 invasion of Iraq, and Ramadi 2004-2005 with 1/503rd Infantry as a Forward Observer. He is an FAA Division Manager for AI & Data Analytics in Long Beach, California, and has been in federal service since 2010. The Ghosts We Carry is his first book.

- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sbogucki12
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bogoodskighosts
